notes.title: eteeConnect 2025.011.06 beta release - eteeConnect v3 & Dongle FW Update 1.2.9
notes.content:
[quote=author][b]FEEBACK REQUEST[/b]
We really appreciate all of your feedback; it is what helps us identify areas to improve and work on. 
You may reach out to us on our official [url=https://discord.com/invite/3C7dXkFAuu]etee discord[/url] or through our [url=https://eteexr.com/pages/contact-us]website[/url].
Stay tuned! More exciting features coming! ːsteamthisː
[/quote]

We invite you to try out the new beta version of eteeConnect, featuring an updated configuration page with enhanced functionality. The new page allows you to:

[list]
[*]Easily switch between custom tracker positions
[*]Set controller binding profiles
[*]Adjust the brightness of your dongle's LED
[*]Additionally, you can upgrade to our latest eteeDongle Firmware version 1.2.9.
[/list]

To navigate the new configuration UI, simply click one of the three icons on the left side of the page to explore each settings section.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41582509/4dffd50e25607e43ebb37a8480dc5f82db951790.png[/img]

[h2]How to opt into the beta[/h2]
To activate the beta release you will have:
[list]
[*] Activate the eteeConnect [b]beta branch[/b] (see details below)
[*] Update your dongle firmware version to [b]1.2.9[/b] (see details below)
[/list]
[h3]Activate the eteeConnect [beta][/h3]
[olist]
[*]In Steam, navigate to: "[i]Steam > eteeConnect > Settings[/i]".
[*]Enter the "[i]Betas[/i]" section.
[*]Under "[i]Beta Participation[/i]", click on the dropdown-menu and select: "[i]beta - External Testing[/i]".
[*]If the beta was activated successfully, you will see a [i][beta][/i] tag next to your eteeConnect app name.

notes.title: eteeConnect 2024.07.25 VRChat Update & Compatibility - SteamVR Input 2.0
notes.content:
[quote=author][b]VRCHAT - STEAMVR INPUT 2.0 & SKELETONS[/b]
Hi everyone!

VRChat is updating their Unity plugin to access the SteamVR Input 2.0 system (see the [url=https://feedback.vrchat.com/feature-requests/p/steamvr-input-20]VRChat announcement[/url]). In order for etee to continue working with the latest VRChat updates, our community collaborators have greatly helped us prepare new bindings for you, compatible with SteamVR Input 2.0. More details below!

🎉 Big shoutout to the amazing [b]Hekky[/b] and [b]Carbonated Piss[/b], for their time and help! 🎉 You guys are amazing!
[/quote]

[h2]1. Basic Information[/h2]
For VRChat, our users will need to activate the correct etee bindings, depending on whether or not they're entering the VRChat [open-beta]:
[list]
[*] [b]Old etee bindings - V3_5[/b]: for players who don't want to upgrade VRChat. Note that if users are in VRChat's [open-beta] and use this old binding, they won’t be able to see their hands moving in VRChat due to skeletal incompatibility.
[*] [b]New etee bindings - V4_1[/b]: for players who have updated VRChat to the [open-beta] branch.
[/list]
[b]Note[/b]: As a rule of thumb, if you cannot see your fingers moving in VRChat, activate another binding.

[h2]2. Am I activating the correct binding?[/h2]
[previewyoutube=ibHxlns2frA;full][/previewyoutube]
[b]How it looks if you don't activate the correct binding[/b]
For example, if you have updated VRChat to the [open-beta] but you have the old bindings (V3_5) selected, your finger movement will not be registered. 

[b]How it looks if you activate the correct binding[/b]
For example, if you have updated VRChat to the [open-beta] and you have the new bindings (V4_1) selected, your finger movement will be registered correctly.


[h2]3. How to activate the changes for VRChat [open-beta][/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41582509/56dbd6be5b78406c0155aacbc248a9971a750e43.png[/img]
To activate the changes you will have to:
[list]
[*] Make sure you have updated eteeConnect.
[*] Open SteamVR and VRChat (in "open-beta" mode).
[*] Open the Bindings UI menu, by navigating to: "SteamVR Settings > Devices > Open Binding UI". (Note: If you cannot see this option, check if you have activated "Show Advanced Options" in the bottom-left side of the SteamVR Settings Menu)
[*] In the Binding UI menu:
[list]
[*] Select the VRChat game.
[*] Select the eteeController as your device.
[*] Click on "Activate" in any of the V4_1 etee bindings for VRChat (recommended: [ANY TRACKER - NEW SKELETON]).
[/list]
[/list]

[h2]4. Game Bindings[/h2]
Here's a quick diagram showing the game bindings for the V4_1 bindings for VRChat [open-beta] users.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41582509/4c069627adbb58d647ffe49d96fdcef4b6b244ea.jpg[/img]

notes.title: eteeConnect 2024.05.10 major update - VIVE Ultimate Trackers
notes.content:
[quote=author][b]About VIVE Ultimate Trackers[/b]
We're happy to announce that eteeControllers can now be integrated with the VIVE Ultimate Trackers! The VIVE Ultimate Tracker is the new generation of VR trackers by HTC. Unlike previous VIVE trackers, these devices require no base stations. 

The result: A tracking system that is compatible with [b]standalone VR headsets[/b] like the VIVE XR Elite and VIVE Focus 3, as well as third-party PC VR headsets like the Oculus Quest Pro.

For a detailed guide on how to setup your VR system with the eteeControllers and the VIVE Ultimate Trackers, check our article here: 
[url=https://eteexr.com/blogs/news/set-up-eteecontrollers-with-vive-ultimate-trackers]https://eteexr.com/blogs/news/set-up-eteecontrollers-with-vive-ultimate-trackers[/url]

Happy gaming! 👾
[/quote]

[h2]1. Basic Information[/h2]
This release allows you to use VIVE Ultimate Trackers with your eteeControllers in SteamVR, making it possible to track your finger movements in VR without base stations.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41582509/dcde4202f6e36f705ca828f70944ad68dd9f3257.png[/img]

[h2]2. How to activate the changes[/h2]
To activate the release you will have to:
[list]
[*] Follow our detailed guide to setup your etee with the VIVE Ultimate Trackers [url=https://eteexr.com/blogs/news/set-up-eteecontrollers-with-vive-ultimate-trackers]here[/url].
[*] Remember to update your eteeConnect app via Steam. 
[list]
[*] In the "Steam Client App", right-click on the eteeConnect app in your library list. 
[*] Select "Properties" from the dropdown list, then in the "Local Files" tab select "Verify integrity of game".
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41582509/40b5dcedfaaec682f8d3e312ea218222ec06dd13.png[/img]
[/list]

[h2]3. List of changes[/h2]

[h3]etee driver for SteamVR[/h3]
[b]New release version available[/b]: etee driver for SteamVR - v1.4.6.release
[list]
[*] Implemented detection and filtering for VIVE Ultimate Trackers.
[*] Added device offsets to the [b]eteeController + eteeAdapter + VIVE Ultimate Tracker[/b] combination.
[/list]

notes.title: eteeConnect 2024.04.22 major update - Battery
notes.content:
[quote=author][b]SUCCESSFUL BETA[/b]
We're happy to announce our [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/1590110/announcements/detail/4178851594847278197]last beta[/url], aimed to improve etee's battery lifetime, is ready for public release! 🎉 Many thanks to everyone who helped us test the changes!

We received great feedback from our beta users and were able to fix the bug causing some controllers to turn off prematurely, even when there was still power left in the batteries. 

Many thanks for your patience and happy gaming!
[/quote]

[h2]1. Basic Information[/h2]
This release focuses on improving battery lifetime through the following changes:
[list]
[*][b] New firmware - Fuel gauge[/b]: Better battery management and fuel gauge algorithms. Previously, errors in the fuel gauge estimations of the BQ27441 component caused the controller to turn off prematurely, even when there was much battery remaining. The new firmware implements a new algorithm to detect battery level and allow you to safely use all of etee's power. 
[list]
[*][b]Note[/b]: The new average battery lifetime is [b]4.5-5h[/b] with haptics, up to [b]6h[/b] without haptics (navigate to the end of the page to learn how to deactivate haptics).
[/list]
[*][b] More efficient haptics in SteamVR[/b]: Same user experience, less battery consumption for the etee haptics (aka. vibrations) in VR.
[/list]

[h2]2. How to activate the changes[/h2]
To activate the release you will have to:
[list]
[*] Update your left and right controllers firmware version to [b]1.3.10[/b]. (see details below)
[*] Make sure to update your eteeConnect app via Steam. 
[list]
[*] In the "Steam Client App", right-click on the eteeConnect app in your library list. Select "Properties" from the dropdown list, then in the "Local Files" tab select "Verify integrity of game".
[/list]
[/list]

[h3]2.1. Update your controller firmware version[/h3]
[olist]
[*]Connect the controllers to your laptop or PC using a USB-C cable.
[*]Run the [i]eteeConnect[/i] app, and navigate to: "[i]eteeConnect > Options > Firmware Update[/i]". If the device you want to update is detected, you will see its version number. If you cannot see this, re-plug the USB-C cable connected to the device and wait.
[*]Next to the device, click on the drop-down menu and select version: [b]1.3.10[/b]. 
[*]Click "[i]Update[/i]".
[*]To check if the firmware was updated successfully, check the firmware version number on the left, under the device name.
[/olist]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41582509/6333a964e08f77758590c916becd2e3fe6a2d17c.png[/img]

[h2]3. List of changes[/h2]

[h3]3.1. eteeController firmware[/h3]
[b]New version available[/b]: 1.3.10

[b]Instructions:[/b] To update your controllers, please, use eteeConnect. Connect your devices to your PC/laptop using a USB-C cable, and go to: Options > Update > Firmware.

[b]Changes to firmware:[/b] 
[list]
[*] Better battery level management, using voltage levels for low and critical battery statuses in eteeControllers.
[*] Improved battery level estimation algorithms.
[/list]
[h3]3.2. etee driver for SteamVR[/h3]
[b]New release version available[/b]: etee driver for SteamVR - v1.4.5.release
[list]
[*] Implemented more efficient haptic patterns, while ensuring the same user experience.
[*] New bindings for Pistol Whip & Budget Cuts 1 added.
[/list]

[quote=author][b]HOW TO DISABLE ETEE HAPTICS IN STEAMVR[/b]
[olist]
[*]In Steam, navigate to: "[i]Steam > eteeConnect > Settings[/i]".
[*]Enter the "[i]Installed Files[/i]" section, and click the [i]Browse[/i] button to open the folder where eteeConnect is located.
[*]Within the directory, navigate to the [i]"eteeConnect > resources > settings"[/i] folder, and open the "[b][i]default.vrsettings[/i][/b]" file with your favourite editor. We recommend [url=https://notepad-plus-plus.org/]Notepad++[/url] or [url=https://code.visualstudio.com/]VSCode[/url], but you can even use text editor available in your OS.
[*]Navigate to the end of the document, and under "[b][i]etee_haptic_settings[/i][/b]" change enable to [b]false[/b] to disable haptics. Make sure to not add any commas after this.
[*]Now you're ready to run SteamVR, and the changes should have been applied.
[/olist]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41582509/d351f22ae4bfcbdfee88b6b15074ff389f7586c8.png[/img]
[/quote]

notes.title: eteeConnect 2023.12.11 stability update
notes.content:
[h2]List of changes[/h2]

[h3]eteeConnect - Fix for firmware upload[/h3]
[b]New version available[/b]: eteeConnect- 2.15.0

[b]Changes to software[/b]:
[list]
[*]Re-designed the firmware upload process and completed stability improvements.
[*]Added automatic dongle plug events and connection statuses.
[*]Removed eteeConnect update option page to avoid confusion. The user is advised to update the app from the Steam Store, or set the app in Steam to [b]automatically update[/b].
[*]Other stability bugfixes
[/list]
[b]Note[/b]: Sometimes after uploading new firmware, the controllers might disconnect from the dongle. If this happens, you may need to manually restart (i.e. turn OFF/ON) your eteeControllers.

notes.title: eteeConnect 2023.12.11 new feature release
notes.content:
[h2]List of changes[/h2]

[h3]eteeConnect - Trackpad Tuning[/h3]
[b]New version available[/b]: eteeConnect- 2.14.0
[b]Note[/b]: The new version of etee firmware (v.1.3.9) is required to use this feature. More details below.

[b]Changes to software[/b]:
[list]
[*] Enable or disable a [b]trackpad deadzone[/b] (default: enabled)
[*] Allow for user-tuned deadzone ranges
[*] Left and Right hand can have different trackpad deadzone values
[list]
[*] To switch between controller profiles A and B: triple-click the power button and wait for 4 sec.
[*] Suggestion: you can change the controller LED colour for profiles A and B, making it easy to identify them.
[*] Allow to switch profiles in the deadzone tuning page. 
[/list]
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41582509/6c10dc6bcf503075b8d5b7fe23eab31e70dcd083.png[/img]

[h3]etee firmware - Trackpad Tuning[/h3]
[b]New version available[/b]: eteeController - 1.3.9.stable.0

[b]Changes to firmware[/b]:
[list]
[*] Firmware update to support new eteeConnect's [b]trackpad tuning[/b] feature.
[*] Integrate new deadzone algorithm.
[*] Flash memory updates for eteeConnect profile setting.
[/list]

[quote=author][b]INSTRUCTIONS TO USE TRACKPAD TUNING FEATURE[/b]
.
[b](1) UPDATE DEVICE FIRMWARE[/b]
[b]New controller firmware[/b]: 1.3.9.stable.0
[list]
[*] Run the [i]eteeConnect[/i] app.
[*] Navigate to: "[i]eteeConnect > Options[/i]".
[*] Under "[i]Update > eteeControllers Firmware[/i]", click on the drop-down menu and select version: [b] 1.3.9.stable.0[/b]. Click "[i]Update[/i]".
[*] Follow the instructions to update controllers firmware.
[*] To check if the firmware was updated successfully, navigate again to "[i]Options > Update > eteeControllers Firmware[/i]" and click on the refresh icon. Your version should have changed to [i]1.3.9.stable.0[/i].
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41582509/722b723ca2929812ba0886f6b1a0f9926e8607cc.png[/img]

[b](2)TUNE THE DEADZONE[/b]
[b]New eteeConnect version[/b]: 2.14.0
[list]
[*] Make sure you have updated your eteeConnect application to 2.14.0. You can check your current version under: "[i]eteeConnect > Options > Update > eteeConnect Version[/i]".
[*] In eteeConnect, navigate to: "[i]eteeConnect > Bindings[/i]".
[*] Triple-click the etee power button to change to the desired profile (either A or B).
[b]Note[/b]: To easily identify profiles, we recommend changing the LED color for each profile.
[*] Enter a desired profile (either A or B) by clicking on the "Edit Profile" button.
[*] On the top-right menu, navigate to "eteeTrackpad > DeadZone". You can use this to tune the deadzone range.
[/list]
[/quote]

[quote=author][b]NEW CONTROLLER INTERACTIONS WITH NEW FIRMWARE[/b]
If you decide to flash the beta firmware ([b]v.1.3.9.stable.0[/b]), some interactions might change:
[olist]
[*]The trackpad will behave like a [b]physical joystick[/b]. For best results, first place the thumb at the center of the trackpad and then move it to where you want the X-Y to be. If you first press the edge of the trackpad, this would be filtered out.
[*]For games such as VRChat, some actions were binded to tap on the trackpad East or West DPAD coordinates (i.e. snap turn). Now, instead of touching those edges directly, you will need to [b]swipe[/b] to snap turn left/right.
[/olist]
[/quote]

[h3]etee driver for SteamVR[/h3]
[b]New version available[/b]: eteeDriver - 1.4.4
[list]
[*] [b]etee Custom driver VRChat hand offset pose update[/b]
[list]
[*] The hand offset pose has been updated. The hand model offsets have been improved, and the skeleton aligns with models from Index controllers. This fixes issues such as unusual elbow behaviour when rotating your hands. This provides a better user experience and improved skeleton behaviour in VRChat.

notes.title: eteeConnect 2023.08.03 major update
notes.content:
[h2]Basic Information[/h2]

This update includes several features that have passed the beta phase and are now available in the stable release. The focus was on controller firmware and onboarding new features into the device to simplify data flow.

[quote=author][b]A BIG THANK YOU[/b]
Thanks to everyone who participated in the betas and shared their feedback. We were able to identify bugs and iterate through versions because of your support. 

For more information on the betas, check these Release Patch Notes:
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1590110/view/6252732681181200515]First Beta[/url], [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1590110/view/3644023137750589264]Second Beta[/url], [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1590110/view/3653030971910805125]Third Beta[/url].
[/quote]

[h2]List of changes[/h2]

[h3]etee firmware[/h3]
[b]New version available[/b]: 1.3.7.stable.0

[b]Changes to firmware[/b]:
[list]
[*] [b]Dynamic baselines[/b]: Should eliminate the need for quick calibration (i.e. double-click power button). Note: feature still available if needed.
[*] [b]Input filtering[/b]: Embedded input filters into the devices, resulting in less input mis-triggering.
[*] [b]Stability improvement[/b]:
[list]
[*] Removed light sleep feature. After 5 minutes of inactivity, the controllers will directly turn off, instead of entering the previous light sleep mode.
[*] Reduced confusing LED status from eteeControllers where when the controller is disconnected from a dongle, it would try to mimic the LED status of the eteeTracker.
[*] Resolved controller freezing and not turning ON due to an edge-case when the device is critically low in battery.[/list][/list]
[quote=author][b]INSTRUCTION TO UPDATE DEVICE FIRMWARE[/b]
[olist]
[*]Run the [i]eteeConnect[/i] app.
[*]Navigate to: "[i]eteeConnect > Options[/i]".
[*]Under "[i]Update > eteeControllers Firmware[/i]", click on the drop-down menu and select version: [b]1.3.7.stable.0[/b]. Click "[i]Update[/i]".
[*]Follow the instructions to update controllers firmware.
[*]To check if the firmware was updated successfully, navigate again to "[i]Options > Update > eteeControllers Firmware[/i]" and click on the refresh icon. Your version should have changed to [i]1.3.7.stable.0[/i].
[/olist]
[/quote]

[h3]etee driver for SteamVR[/h3]
[b]New release version available[/b]: etee driver for SteamVR - v1.4.1.
[list]
[*] Developed a release version compatible with the new firmware.
[*] [b]Binding Autoremapping[/b]: Implemented autoremapping feature released by SteamVR. This should resolve automatically create a template binding for the etee controllers when no game bindings are available.[/list]

[h2]Known Issues[/h2]

We've identified a few issues and [b]we're working towards fixing them[/b]. In the meantime, please, use the following quick solutions:
[list]
[*] [b]Controller not picked up by SteamVR[/b]: if the controllers are connected to the dongle (dongle LED flashes pink twice) but not to SteamVR, try unplugging and re-plugging the controller.
[*] [b]Controller not picked up by dongle[/b]: if the controllers are not connecting to the dongle (dongle LED flashes pink only once or zero times), try unplugging and re-plugging the controller.
[*] [b]Slider double-click issues[/b]: if you're finding it difficult to perform slider double-click in a game, please perform a quick calibration (double-click power/system button).
[*] [b]Wrist offsets in VRChat[/b]: work in progress.
[/list]

[*][b] Confusing LED status from eteeControllers[/b]: Removed tracker LED synchronisation feature from the eteeControllers.
[*][b] eteeControllers stability[/b]: Removed edge-cases where eteeController would freeze and not work.
[/list]

[h2]2. List of changes[/h2]

[h3]2.1. eteeController firmware[/h3]
[b]New version available[/b]: 1.3.5.beta.1

[b]Instructions:[/b] To update your controllers, please, use eteeConnect. Go to: Options > Update > Firmware, and follow on-screen instructions.

[b]Note - Know Bugs in Beta:[/b]
[quote=Note] There seems to be a bug on the previously released beta firmware (1.3.5.beta.0) where when the controller enters light sleep, the device will either remain stuck in light sleep or once you reactivate the device it will permanently remain active. 

The condition for entering light sleep is as follows;
[list]
[*] 5 minutes of inactivity when the device is connected to a eteeController dongle.
[*] 30 seconds of inactivity when the device is not connected to a eteeController dongle.
[/list]
To resolve this, hard-reset the controller by pressing and holding the power-button for ~13 seconds. 
[b]This bug will still be present in this current update and we are actively working on resolving this and will push an update to fix this.[/b]

[list]
[*] Resolved edge-case scenario where controller would enter light-sleep mode instead of turning OFF and charging.
[*] Resolved edge-case scenario where controller would go into shipping mode when charging.
[*] Resolved freezing issues when controller is charging in the eteeDock.
[*] Resolved confusing LED status during charging.
[*] Improved trackpad sensitivity for North DPAD touch.
[*] Default calibration profile set to number 2.
[/list]

notes.title: eteeConnect 2022.11.03 stability update
notes.content:
[h3]etee driver for SteamVR[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed automatic tracker hand assignment.
[*] Fixed hand controller losing tracking when a temporary physical disconnection between the tracker and controller devices occurs.
[*] Added new event printouts to the SteamVR system log, and more specific information on the active build version.
[/list]

notes.title: eteeConnect 2022.10.28 stability update
notes.content:
[h3]etee driver for SteamVR[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed controller render model being flipped upside down and general instability in start-up behaviour.
[*] Improve controller poses from trackers.
[*] Improvements to how trackers are discovered by controllers to mitigate issues with two controllers connecting to one tracker.
[*] If controllers are disconnected from trackers they will now disappear in SteamVR.
[/list]

[h3]VR Chat and Boneworks[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed the missing mapping to enable finger tracking feature.
[/list]

[h3]Half life Alyx[/h3]
[list]
[*] The bindings have been remapped so it is more consistent with the bindings made for other games.
[*] In-game menu is activated by double clicking the proximity button instead of a single click.
[*] Gun fire is activated by the pinch gesture. 
[*] Stand/crouch toggle is activated by double clicking the LED slider on the left controller.
[*] Laser-sight and burst-fire toggle is activated by double clicking the thumb button on the right controller.
[/list]

notes.title: eteeConnect 2022.10.24 eteeController binding updates
notes.content:
[h3]Beat Saber[/h3]
[list]
[*] The in game menu is now activated with a double tap instead of the previous single click held on the proximity button.
[/list]
[h3]Walkabout Mini Golf[/h3]
[list]
[*] The existing binding created wasn't included in the driver which has now been added.
[*] The menu has been changed from a double-tap on the slider to a double-tap on the proximity button.
[/list]
[h3]Moondust[/h3]
[list]
[*] The menu is now launched by a double-tap on the proximity button instead of a single click on the proximity button.
[*] The buggy game has throttle controlled with pinch instead of index finger.
[/list]
[h3]OVR advanced settings[/h3]
[list]
[*] The binding wasn't referenced properly which has been fixed.
[/list]
